summary: Resolver ignored Bang vs Dot operator semantics; ! control references could be misresolved as type-library members and Dot-failures at segment 1 were mis-coded as control-not-on-form.
fix: Added ResolveSegment that does strict Controls dictionary lookup for Bang on SyntheticForm/ReportDeclaration parents (preserving JET ! default-member semantics) and made ChooseUnresolvedReason operator-aware so segment-1 Dot failures emit member-not-found-at-segment-1.
